tickets.title: Prepare consolidated equity vesting and trading calendar
tickets.text: Prepare a single calendar for Tobin Mossbutton covering his Copper Firefly Systems option and RSU vesting dates, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps. Include the 9,600 vested shares at Velvet Acorn Custody, the RSUs vesting over the next three years, and the quarterly trading windows and pre-clearance rules.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-12, the agreed follow-up is a single calendar of option and RSU vesting, blackout periods, and pre-clearance steps, requested because planning was relying on memory or portal screenshots.

tickets.title: Build option exercise scenario illustration for Tobin
tickets.text: Build an illustration for Tobin Mossbutton comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, and partial exercise scenarios for his Copper Firefly Systems vested options. Show each scenario against household cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity, including the multiple vested option strike prices identified in the review.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-19, the agreed follow-up is an illustration comparing same-day sale, cash exercise, or partial exercise against cash reserves and payroll withholding capacity, after the review found several vested option strike prices and no household comparison.

tickets.title: Collect Tobin's Copper Firefly equity plan documents
tickets.text: Obtain from Tobin Mossbutton the full Copper Firefly Systems equity plan agreement, grant notices, and insider trading policy. Use these to confirm exercise limits and sale restrictions; Tobin previously showed only the current portal balance.
tickets.evidence: By 2026-08-05, the needed documents are the full equity plan agreement, grant notices, and insider trading policy to confirm exercise limits and sale restrictions; Tobin showed only the current portal balance.
